direct_verifications.detail: Latest Gaza roundup on November 15 at 23:54 Jerusalem time reiterates November 15 casualties; no distinct newer Gaza incident established.
November 15 listings include previously captured Rafah al-Mawasi strike, UNICEF appeal, and four-country statement; no new later Gaza item found.
November 16-dated recap explicitly describes November 15 deaths, Khan Younis injury, and four-minister appeal; date of recap does not mean new November 16 events.
November 16 at 00:13 Jerusalem time recaps Sunday, November 15 events already surfaced earlier; not an hourly new event.

excluded_candidates: Al Araby November 16 article is a recap of Sunday November 15 Rafah al-Mawasi attack, Khan Younis shooting, Abdullah Hassouna's earlier-wounds death, and joint diplomatic appeal already present in earlier watch findings.
Al-Quds November 16 at 00:13 Jerusalem time reports two prior-day deaths/injuries; no distinct additional event beyond earlier logged Gaza incidents.
WAFA November 15 latest list includes earlier-reported Rafah casualties, UNICEF aid-access appeal, and four-government joint statement, without a separately verified new event.
November 15 reporting of a claimed Hamas commander killed lacks an independently documented civilian impact and is outside this watch's positive-finding criterion.
Older Nasser Hospital strike, flood/shelter figures, medical shipments and OCHA November 13 figures were not reclassified as new.
caveats: Search coverage is time-bounded and nonexhaustive; late indexing can surface relevant older unique incidents in later checks.
WHO Eastern Mediterranean HTTP 502 remains a source-access limitation but is not a newly material degradation; WHO global and OCHA remained accessible.
Some news search results dated November 16 refer to events on November 15 in Jerusalem time; these were cross-checked for novelty.
